claims.quote: No one else on deck saw the ghost; Laila's jaw set around nothing and Nasir kept his hands working the rope.
Around them, other voices rose—some the ship's, some the sea's. The memory-storm took many forms the map had warned about: fog-phantoms, sudden scents, echoed voices, music that drags at a name.
claims.value: fog-phantoms, sudden scents, echoed voices, music that drags at a name

claims.quote: The coven preserved memory with named rituals; they feared removing anchors.
claims.value: preserve memory with named rituals; fear of removing anchors

claims.quote: Anchors were plain things—counting, named ritual, physical token—and any one of them could hold a name against the island's unpicking.
